parts.text: Which question has been made scientific by turning curiosity into a focused question that can guide careful observation and a check?

options.text: "Does sugar dissolve faster in warm water or in cold water?" because it is focused and can be checked.
"Why does all energy do things?" because a big curiosity question is already scientific.
The sugar question is not scientific because it uses kitchen materials.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Ojas writes two questions after watching sugar dissolve: "Why does all energy do things?" and "Does sugar dissolve faster in warm water or in cold water?"

part_answers.answer: The sugar question is focused and can guide observation or a fair test; the energy question is too broad to check.

teacher.key_rationale: A scientific question is focused and can guide careful observation and explanation. The sugar question can; the energy question is too broad.
